# Print Axis Pro

> Offline-first print layout editor for exact-size photo and document printing. Place images at precise mm/cm/inch dimensions, arrange multi-page layouts, and export to PDF, DOCX, PNG or JPG.

Print Axis Pro is an installable Android PWA. It works fully offline, supports passport and ID templates, PDF import, and Android Share Target for sharing images directly into the editor.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Main editor with paper canvas, image import, layout tools and export.
